out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter throughout kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. PIC placed wet wiping cloths in sanitizer solution.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed cups without handle using as a dispensing utensils to dispense seasonings.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC removed the cup from food containers and understands dispensing utensils should have a handle if stored inside food items.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed unsalted butter in squeeze bottle sitting on the counter next to the 2 DR prep table (R).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded unsalted butter.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no quaternary ammonia test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: PIC obtained a quaternary ammonia test kit during inspection.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: Observed burnt out LED lights under hood in the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC replaced LED lights during inspection.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Design/Install per Law
violations.observation: The plumbing system serving this food service facility has not been designed, constructed, and installed according to the Plumbing Code. Observed not approved splitter attached to the faucet of mop sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be designed, constructed, and installed according to Law. PIC disconnected splitter from the faucet.
